terms.comment: The word is “sweepings, rubbish” (see rubbish); as an exclamation it is Traupman’s. Nūgās! is the comic word.

evidence: Ter. Heaut. 2.3.95; And. 1.3.19 (Lewis & Short s.v. fābula)
Plaut. Curc. 5.2.6: Nūgās garrīs. — Soleō. (Lewis & Short s.v. soleō)
Traupman p. 104: you are talking nonsense, nūgās garrīs
Traupman p. 104: cut out the nonsense, omitte nūgās
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase, built like Plautus’ aufer nūgās (above), which says the same thing in attested words.
